item.title: Bulletin updated at 08:10 HKT 20/Jul/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The subtropical ridge will cover southeastern China today, but there will also be a few showers over the region. The tropical cyclone now over the central part of the South China Sea will have a higher chance to move towards the vicinity of Hainan Island and western Guangdong in the next couple of days. However, its movement and development are still quite uncertain. The associated squally showers and thunderstorms are expected to affect the coast of Guangdong early next week. It will be windy over the region. Besides, the tropical cyclone over the western North Pacific will move in the general direction of the seas near Taiwan in the next few days.
